Specification: This module defines several equivalent TLA+ formulations of the transitive closure of a binary relation represented as a set of ordered pairs. It develops multiple definitions: one based on paths as sequences, one using bounded sequences for finite relations, one using iterative relational composition, one recursive closure formulation, one Warshall-style recursive algorithm, and one formulation for relations represented as Boolean-valued operators over a set. The module uses assumptions to check, on small finite instances, that these different definitions are equivalent; it does not model a concurrent system or fault model, but rather specifies and compares mathematical definitions and their TLC-evaluable variants.
AssumptionNames:
\A N \in 0..3 : 
          \A R \in SUBSET ((1..N) \X (1..N)) : /\ TC1(R) = TC2(R)
                                               /\ TC2(R) = TC3(R) 
                                               /\ TC3(R) = TC4(R)

\A N \in 0..3 : \A R \in SUBSET ((1..N) \X (1..N)) :
         LET RR(s, t) == <<s, t>> \in R
             S == Support(R)
         IN  \A s, t \in S : 
                TC5(RR, S, s, t) <=> (<<s, t>> \in TC1(R))
IfThenElse: IF n = 0 THEN R ELSE C[n-1] \cup (C[n-1] ** R)
IF RR \subseteq R THEN R ELSE TC3(R \cup RR)

IF T = {} THEN R ELSE LET r == CHOOSE s \in T : TRUE
                           RR == TCR(T \ {r})
                       IN  RR \cup {<<s, t>> \in S \X S : 
                                      <<s, r>> \in RR /\ <<r, t>> \in RR}

IF n = 0 THEN R(s, v)
                   ELSE \/ CR[n-1, v] 
                        \/ \E u \in S : CR[n-1, u] /\ R(u, v)
